'''Mountain Shrine''' (山神社) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} in {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}}, located in various places throughout the country.

== Shōshoi ==
* Located in {{ill|Kamaishi, Iwate|en|Kamaishi, Iwate|qid=Q329790|lt=Kamaishi, Iwate|1=Kamaishi, Iwate}}, Iwate Prefecture. Official name: {{ill|Kamaishi Steelworks Mountain Shrine|ja|釜石製鐵所山神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kamaishi Steelworks Mountain Shrine|1=Nippon Steel Corporation North Nippon Works San Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q60988202}}.
